shortDescription: US based not-for-profit health system Bon Secours Mercy Health is in late-stage talks to buy a majority stake in Surgery Partners NASDAQ:SGRY in a deal which would value the company at roughly $6 billion including debt, the Financial Times reported on Sunday.Here are a few details:

children: US based not-for-profit health system Bon Secours Mercy Health is in late-stage talks to buy a majority stake in Surgery Partners
in a deal which would value the company at roughly $6 billion including debt, the Financial Times reported on Sunday.
The potential, deal which could be announced as early as Monday, values the short-stay surgery operator at about $20 a share, the report said, citing people familiar with the matter
Bon Secours Mercy Health and Surgery Partners did not immediately respond to Reuters request for comment outside regular business hours
Bain Capital, its largest shareholder, will retain its almost 40 per cent shareholding in Surgery Partners as part of the take-private deal, the report added
The potential deal would represent a 25.8% premium to Surgery Partners' last close of $15.9, as per LSEG data.
Surgery Partners rejected Bain Capital's take-private offer in June last year, saying it was unable to agree to the terms set by the private equity group
